title: Postgres connection pool exhaustion
symptom_pattern: Database connection pool exhausted, connections queued, upstream API timeouts, HTTP 5xx spike on order endpoints, query statement timeouts
root_cause: Connection leak in order-api after deploy 2026-06-28; pool never released connections on aborted transactions
resolution: Rolled back order-api to previous release, restarted pgbouncer to clear queued connections

title: Redis memory pressure with cache stampede
symptom_pattern: Redis used memory at maxmemory with active key evictions, cache miss rate spike, database CPU climbing from fallthrough reads, session lookup failures logging users out
root_cause: TTL misconfiguration cached large session blobs without expiry after session-service release
resolution: Flushed session keyspace, restored TTLs, temporarily raised maxmemory and scaled read replicas

title: Log partition disk full crash-looping workers
symptom_pattern: Disk usage critical on /var/log, pods crash-looping with no-space-left write errors, kubelet unhealthy, job throughput stalled to zero
root_cause: Debug logging left enabled on payment-worker, wrote 40GB in 36 hours; logrotate config missing for the new log path
resolution: Truncated logs, disabled debug flag, added logrotate rule and disk-usage alert at 80%

title: Identity provider JWKS outage cascading auth failures
symptom_pattern: JWT token validation failures with JWKS endpoint 503, 401 rejection spike at gateway, login success rate collapse across mobile and web clients
root_cause: Upstream identity provider rotated signing keys during their maintenance; JWKS cache TTL too short to ride it out
resolution: Enabled stale-JWKS fallback cache, extended cache TTL to 24h, added circuit breaker on validation path

title: Inter-AZ packet loss from degraded switch
symptom_pattern: High packet loss between availability zone subnets, gRPC deadline exceeded errors, replica lag climbing, Kafka in-sync replicas shrinking, metric scrape failures
root_cause: Failing optic on top-of-rack switch caused intermittent frame drops between subnet-a and subnet-c
resolution: Drained traffic to redundant path, replaced optic, verified replica catch-up before restoring

title: Kafka consumer group rebalance storm
symptom_pattern: Message queue depth rising, consumer lag alerts, repeated consumer group rebalances, notification delivery stalled
root_cause: Slow consumer exceeded max.poll.interval, triggering continuous rebalance loop across the group
resolution: Raised max.poll.interval.ms, reduced batch size on the slow consumer, lag drained in 20 minutes

title: Certificate expiry breaking internal mTLS
symptom_pattern: TLS handshake failures between internal services, connection refused spikes, health checks failing across the mesh
root_cause: Internal CA intermediate certificate expired; auto-renewal job had been silently failing for two weeks
resolution: Re-issued intermediate cert, restarted sidecars, added expiry monitoring on the renewal job itself

title: Runaway deploy CPU-starving colocated pods
symptom_pattern: Node CPU saturation, throttled pods, latency degradation on colocated services, HPA scaling storm
root_cause: New recommendation-service release missing CPU limits pinned all cores on shared nodes
resolution: Applied resource limits, evicted and rescheduled the offending pods, backfilled limit policy in CI
